content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 3.4 already gives Bluefly a Customer-only convenience right (Agreement or any Service Option Attachment) on one month's notice, and IBM has no mid-term convenience right — both better than our fallback. The one material failure is Section 3.4(b)'s open-ended early termination charges, cross-referring to Attachment A and Service Option Attachments that IBM can unilaterally change under 13.1. I proposed a single surgical insertion capping those charges at three (3) months' charges, leaving all other wording verbatim, and noted (without redlining) the absence of a pro-rata prepaid-fee refund as a preferred-only sub-element.
